## Add NewSub-Clause26.5as follows:

## 26.5 SubmissionofCertificateapplication

Whenever thewordtriplicateismentionedhereinClause26 itshallbe replaced by electronic submission of Interim Certificate application throughthcautomationapplicationinstructedbytheEmployer.The Contractorshallbesolelyliableforanydelayresultedfromhisfailureto apply on the application, and the Employer shall not be under any obligationtoreleaseInterimPaymentCertificateunlesscommunicated throughtheautomationapplication.

The Employer shall provide the Contractor with access lo the automation applicationandwithtechnicalsupportneeded.

## 27. PAYMENT

## 27.1 TimeofPayment

In paragraph (b) of this Sub-Clause 27.1, replace the 30 days with 15 days.

## Add NewSub-Clause 27.1(A)as follows:

## 27.1 (A) Delayed Payments

- a.If the Fmployer fails to pay the Contractor the amount due under any InterimCertificateissuedbytheContractAdministratorinaccordance withSub-Clause(h)of Clause26.2(lssueof InlerimCertificates)within thirty (30) days after the expiry of the time stated in Sub-Clause 27.1(b) withinwhichpaymentistobemade,subjecttoanydeductionthatthe Employerisentitled tomakeunder theContract theContractorshall be entitledtoreceiveinterestson theamountunpaidduring theperiod of delay from the expiry date of the time stated in sub-clause 27.1.b. Calculated at the annual Lending Rate of the Central Bank of Egypt.
- b.If the Employer fails lo pay the Contractor the amount due under anyInterim Certificate issued by the Contract Administrator in accordance with Sub-Clause (h) of Clause 26.2 (lssue of Interim Certificates) within lhirty (30) days after the expiry of the tirme slaled in entitled to make under the Contract, the Contractor may, without prejudlce toIts right for interests under Sub-Clause (a) hereof,after giving thirty(30) dayspriornotice to the Employer,with a copy to the ContractAdministrator,reducetherateofwork.
